{
  "candidate": "cand_0002",
  "headline": "Kill the confirm-then-###STOP### stall with a decisive-execution rule; reverse the wrong basic-economy cabin-upgrade refusal; add an atomic modify_reservation composite for multi-write tasks.",
  "clusters": [
    {"id": "A", "name": "Confirm-then-STOP stall",
     "detail": "Agent gathers all details then ends its turn on a standalone 'Shall I proceed?'. User replies 'yes###STOP###' and the episode terminates before the write tool is ever called, so the DB is unchanged and the task scores 0. Passing trials execute the write directly once details are known.",
     "tasks": ["8", "12", "19", "40", "17", "22", "23", "25"],
     "scope": "SYSTEMIC", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "B", "name": "Basic-economy cabin upgrade wrongly refused",
     "detail": "Agent conflates 'basic economy flights cannot be modified' with 'cabin cannot change'. Policy allows a cabin upgrade on basic economy (same flights). Agent refused, user abandoned the task.",
     "tasks": ["22", "17"],
     "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "C", "name": "Over-transfer / abandon after partial write",
     "detail": "Agent completes some writes then transfers to a human out of price confusion (hand-computing rather than trusting the tool's returned figure), leaving later writes undone.",
     "tasks": ["17", "8", "19", "23"],
     "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "D", "name": "Multi-write tasks abandoned partway",
     "detail": "Tasks needing flights + passengers + baggages require three confirm->write cycles; the agent stalls/abandons before finishing all three.",
     "tasks": ["17", "22"],
     "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"}
  ],
  "edits": [
    {"id": "E1", "title": "Rewrite RULE 1 as a decision chain: once all details are held, the turn must end in the write tool call, never a bare 'Shall I proceed?'",
     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
     "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "WIDE",
     "verified": "Read through against failing trials 8/12/19/40 t0 (turns resolve to a direct write) and passing 11/37/40 t1/t2 (already execute directly, so unchanged)."},
    {"id": "E2", "title": "Reconcile base confirmation line to defer to RULE 1 (remove stacked contradiction)",
     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "CONTRACT",
     "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
     "verified": "Read: no longer hard-requires a separate confirmation turn; cross-references RULE 1."},
    {"id": "E3", "title": "Add rule: a cabin change IS allowed on basic economy (flights-vs-cabin distinction)",
     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
     "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Policy source confirms: 'all reservations, including basic economy, can change cabin without changing the flights.' Reverses task 22 refusal."},
    {"id": "E4", "title": "Tighten transfer/finish rules: never transfer over an unsure number; finish every write of a multi-part request",
     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
     "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
     "verified": "Read against 17 t2 / 8 t1 / 19 t1 / 23 t1 over-transfer turns."},
    {"id": "E5", "title": "New composite atomic-write tool modify_reservation(reservation_id, payment_id, cabin?, flights?, passengers?, total_baggages?)",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py", "policy/policy.md"], "lever": "CAPABILITY",
     "clusters": ["D", "A"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
     "verified": "Live DB: FQ8APE -> economy+Omar Rossi+3 bags = $209 atomic; GV1N64 cabin-only downgrade = $5244 refund (== task 11 gold); count-mismatch error propagates; $0 baggage path clean; 15 tools register; py_compile clean."}
  ],
  "skipped": [
    {"title": "Remove update_* primitives behind modify_reservation", "reason": "Passing tasks 11/37/40 call the primitives directly; bare removal is a large regression risk. Kept additive."},
    {"title": "Task 25", "reason": "max_steps search loop / user ###OUT-OF-SCOPE### on missing DOB — partly infra/no-win; not optimized against."}
  ],
  "techniques": ["decision-chain prose rewrite with worked right/wrong examples", "resolve stacked rule contradiction", "add sourced knowledge rule", "composite atomic-write tool (SKILL lever 2)", "literal per-parameter slot-filling docs for a mid-tier reader", "live-DB verification of every code path"]
}
